CODE-READ COMPLETE (daemonkit main + captain-hook f7c2373, all cites CONFIRMED in code). Lineage correction: no launchd-job ancestor, no worker child process indirection — brew runs capt-hookd package-install in-process (formula post_install), which calls Converge in-process; the spawn chain is shell/brew → capt-hookd → /bin/sh (wrapper) → exec launchctl. The ENTIRE delta vs a successful interactive launchctl is four spawn attributes from proc.prepareCommand: (1) Env scrubbed to exactly PATH + LANG=C (proc/manager.go:1143; service/runner.go:37-40 never sets Env; zero HOME= in the module), (2) SysProcAttr Setsid:true (manager.go:1149), (3) Dir=/bin, (4) pipe stdio. Confirmed ABSENT repo-wide: bootstrap-port/audit-session/responsibility/posix_spawnattr manipulation. The fd3/fd4 wrapper closes both before exec (ruled out).

RANKED: C1 env scrub first — the only candidate whose confirmed precondition naturally covers the interaction term (.app-Program and session-keyed bootstraps drive LaunchServices/BTM registration reading HOME/TMPDIR/__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING/CFPreferences; plain keyless executables skip that path). C2 setsid second, partially counter-indicated in code: the managername probe (controller.go:586) runs through the IDENTICAL spawn path and reports Aqua. C3 responsibility/BTM attribution third (unfixable inside daemonkit). Discriminating test tree gated and running on the local machine: A = C1-alone reproduction (env -i PATH LANG sh-wrapper cwd, no setsid) against the real helper plist; B = C2-alone (full env + os.setsid) if A passes; C = combined if both pass individually. Exit-5 on A pins the env scrub as the fix site (thread Env through runCombined or widen prepareCommand's base env).

ALSO: captain-hook 12.20.11's changelog attributes the EIO to the session-type key — falsified as a standalone mechanism by the field falsifier; correction filed in captain-hook backlog (6ce6ba3). Desired-set recovery wedge questions (the yasyf-home hold) redirected to the same lane as priority.
